notes: L3: the booklet really builds separate models. It has five groups: the umbrella table (pages 3-5), the stool (page 6), the oven with the cake (pages 7-10), the sink (pages 11-12) and the Stephanie figure (page 2). Each has its own build sequence and the final picture (page 13) shows them standing apart. No step joins them, except the cake, which step 6 places on the oven. The groups are kept separate so no connection the booklet does not show is invented.

L1: the parts page (page 14) lists 4219773 once, '1x 4219773', next to the trans-clear oven door. The second count comes from a duplicated, garbled string in the page's text layer ('1x4219773' repeated in the header run-on text). The only place this piece appears is the oven door (page 8 step 4, page 9 step 5), so one is kept.

Element IDs with no catalogue entry were added as new types: 300101, 4650644, 415001, 4616174, 4183544, 4619596, 4220632, 4537936, 4618647, 4216479, 4618629, 4596240, 4600345, 4622859 and 4621993. Their ports are simplified guesses.
The umbrella top has an axle-hole port so it fits on the pole, whose catalogue ports are end.1 and end.2. The pole's other end goes into the centre stud of the 6x6 plate.
The mini-doll joints use ball and socket kinds: hair socket on head ball, head socket on torso ball, torso socket on leg ball.

The inventory lists 4x 614126. Step 3 on page 8 shows one dark round plate going on the container top, so the four are assumed to be the four container studs. Three of the plates are not clearly shown. They are added as b43 to b45 with null ports, because catalogue lego-614126 only has pin-hole.1.
Where a catalogue part has a single stud or anti-stud port but several pieces attach, the extra attachments use null ports.
The sink panels b32 and b33 are given distinct stud positions on the 2x4 brick (stud.3 and stud.4) as an approximation of their actual placement.
Pink round plates 4517996 only have anti-stud.1 in the catalogue, so plates stacked on top of them use null ports on the lower side.
